disposition_reason: The paper explicitly selects mixed-effects terms using model log-likelihood, so an original evaluated fit-comparison route exists for activity/coactivity responses. Its original candidate model set, complexity constraints, likelihood definition, fitting mode, exact analysis rows and numeric results have not been recovered. This potential source-native route remains blocked; it is not predictive validation and cannot be replaced by the local elimination-fate Brier task.

Numeric likelihood/model-selection details are not provided in the reviewed text.

target.description: Recover the original model-log-likelihood comparison for observed activity/coactivity responses with source stability, distance and related covariates. The exact fitted response/comparator set to bind is unresolved; elimination fate is not silently made the response.

dataset.description: Zenodo record 10108836 v1 source-data/code deposit; no archive payload was downloaded in this review.

cohort.description: Retain each original sensor cohort and response-specific retrospective analysis population, including the source longitudinal and elimination-containing-dendrite selection. Exact likelihood-fit rows, mouse/dendrite/spine memberships and repeated observations are not bound.

split.description: The reported likelihood-based term comparison fits the source response data; no held-out predictive split is specified. Leave-one-mouse-out fate prediction is an extension, not this source fit comparison.

inputs.description: Observed activity/coactivity responses, structural stability categories, interspine distances and source session/area terms as applicable, with animal grouping. Preserve the paper response and model-specific covariates.

preprocessing.description: Source alignment, fluorescence event thresholds and normalized coactivity define responses before fitting; exact native transformations, missing-value handling and model-specific analysis-row exclusions remain unverified.

metric.description: Source criterion is model log-likelihood. Its exact marginal/conditional or restricted definition, MATLAB fitlme ML-versus-REML setting, retained constants, response transform and parameterization are unresolved.

aggregation.description: Source groups repeated measurements by animal, with different response models. The exact likelihood computation over observations/clusters and comparison across model variants is unrecovered; do not invent a pooled likelihood across response families.

comparison.primary_metric: Original activity/coactivity-response model log-likelihood comparison, pending exact source model-set and likelihood qualification

published_baseline.description: The source states that model terms were chosen by log-likelihood comparison, but numerical likelihoods, complete candidate/final model set and exact scoring conventions were not recovered. Published effect sizes and p-values do not fill this baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author MATLAB fitlme analyses are documented and source code/data are deposited at Zenodo 10108836; exact model-selection implementation, fitting mode and authentic rerun likelihoods remain unrecovered. The local fate-prediction logistic models are not author baselines.

minimum_effect.rationale: Recover the original admissible model set and complexity policy before defining a meaningful fit improvement. Increasing unpenalized likelihood by adding unconstrained parameters is not sufficient; no new penalty or universal margin is invented.

uncertainty.method: After recovering the original likelihood and fitted model comparison, predeclare a valid matched comparison rule accounting for nesting, parameter counts, random-effect structure and animal dependence. No likelihood-ratio calibration or superiority threshold is asserted here.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse; dendrites, paired spines and repeated session observations remain grouped.
uncertainty.rationale: Dependence and model complexity affect interpretation of likelihood gains; the source significance contrasts are not candidate-superiority tests or held-out validation.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact original activity/coactivity response, candidate/final model formulas, fixed/random effects, analysis rows, transforms and source model-comparison procedure.

Recover numeric source likelihoods and an author replay under the same ML-versus-REML setting, likelihood definition, optimization conventions and admissible complexity; reject incomparable likelihoods.
Preserve the original response and data population. Do not substitute elimination-fate prediction, new held-out folds or a pooled response-family metric.
Freeze the candidate and comparison rule before final evaluation; justify a meaningful likelihood gain with valid uncertainty and complexity safeguards under fixed access/resource budgets.
Do not count stronger p-values, larger biological contrasts, numerical reconstruction, unconstrained parameter addition or beating the local Brier models as paper superiority.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA fit or prediction comparison is established.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending recovery of the original source likelihood-model comparison. A later admitted episode must distinguish source same-sample fit selection from any predictive validation extension.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze source response/model-set bindings, admissible complexity, likelihood/fit convention, analysis population and candidate method before a final comparison; access and resource budgets must also be fixed.
episode.final_evaluation: Unavailable until numeric source baseline, author replay and a same-task likelihood evaluator are qualified. Evaluation must preserve source model-comparison conditions and make no held-out predictive claim.
episode.baseline_policy: Published likelihood results, reproduced author fitlme results and candidate scores must be separate. Preserve existing descriptive reconstructions and local elimination-fate Brier evaluator as calibration/extension only.

blocking_issues: Original candidate/final response-model set, selection procedure, parameter counts and admissible complexity are not recovered.
MATLAB fitlme ML-versus-REML choice, exact likelihood definition/normalization and response-specific aggregation remain unresolved.
Numeric original likelihoods, complete analysis-row bindings and competent author replay are missing.
No qualified source likelihood evaluator, meaningful-effect/uncertainty rule or fixed episode budgets is established.
The local next-visit elimination Brier task changes the response and risk set and cannot fill these source-baseline gaps.

legacy.notes: Preserve initial-evaluator-v1 and generated controls. Its equal-mouse elimination-fate Brier comparison is a locally authored prediction extension, not the paper's activity/coactivity-response likelihood comparison, reproduced author baseline or paper-win grader.
